mia (People Ops): Heads-up: updated short-leave policy posted. Key points: 25-day carryover cap starting 2026, 1 Wellness Day per quarter (no approval), and a short hand-off note required for >5 business days out. Details + templates in the link below.

joe (Engineering Manager): Does the carryover cap affect part-time folks?

mia (People Ops): Part-timers are prorated by FTE. Contractors excluded. We'll send personal statements next week.

rachel (swe): How strict is the 3-day hand-off submission window? Last-minute emergencies happen.

mia (People Ops): Submit 3 business days before when possible; exceptions handled case-by-case. Managers verify hand-offs.

ops-bot: :page_facing_up: Policy updated: https://company.internal/policies/short-leave-2026 (edited by mia)

mia (People Ops): Drop questions here or join the Q&A Tue 10am PST. Template: https://company.internal/hand-offs/template
